$comment: Real-money bets placed outside the frozen three-book structure at the time they were placed. An entry moves out of this file only if a later, deliberate, dated methodology amendment brings it in scope of one of the three books -- it is never deleted, only annotated with where it went.

entries.moved_reason: methodology.md section 12 amended 13 September 2026 to permit accumulators combining a single book's own already-taken selections. This accumulator's three legs are exactly the conclusion book's three taken selections, so it now belongs there rather than here.
entries.note: Originally recorded here because at the moment it was placed, section 12 still read 'no accumulators in the live book.' Kept as a record of that sequence: the bet was placed before the rule permitting it existed, and the rule was changed afterward to accommodate it. Not held up as an example of good process -- flagged, not endorsed.

entries.methodology_conflict: spec/methodology.md section 12 (amended 13 September 2026): an accumulator may only combine selections that a SINGLE book has itself already taken -- never a mix pulled from different books. This one combines 3 conclusion-book legs with 7 Codex-solo legs. Unlike the original MW4 accumulator (which was placed before any accumulator rule existed and got the rule written around it), this one directly contradicts a rule that was already in force when it was placed.
entries.bank_attribution: Not charged against any of the three books' banks -- it structurally can't be, since it isn't one book's own selections. Recorded here as genuinely outside the tracked structure, same treatment as the first deviation before that one got a rule written for it. This one is not expected to get the same treatment -- cross-book accumulators are not something the methodology should accommodate, since it would let a single bet launder together picks the whole point of the three-book design is to score separately.
